expectedText: Have you chosen an activity for the leisure club day next month? Not yet. I want a hobby I can share with my brother, but our fitness levels are different. He is a keen athlete, and I have only recently started to exercise. Have you ever played tennis together? Yes, we have. We borrowed a racket each from the center last year, and I enjoyed it. He wants to try a different sport this time. The gym has a beginner volleyball session at ten. Its coach says no experience is needed, and the equipment is included. That sounds good. My brother has already tried basketball, but I have never played volleyball. We could learn together. There is also an aerobics class at twelve, followed by yoga at two. Both are indoors, so the weather will not matter.
